research.summary: SuiteCRM is an open-source CRM application. The vendor documents a supported-versions page with two tables: 'Currently Supported Versions' and 'End of Life Versions', with month-precision dates for Initial Release, Active Support Until, and Security Support Until columns. There is no API or structured EOL feed.
research.notes: The vendor documents two tables on its supported-versions page. 'Currently Supported Versions' covers 7.15 ESR and 8.10 (both active support). 7.15 ESR has Initial Release (December 2025), Active Support Until (December 2027), and Security Support Until (March 2028). For ESR versions, Security Support Until is the terminal EOL date (the page states 'After active support ends, they receive security-only fixes on an as-needed basis' and 'Non-ESR releases do not have a security-only period'). For non-ESR versions (8.x), Active Support Until is the terminal EOL date because they have no security-only period. The 'End of Life Versions' table lists versions 8.9 through 7.12 ESR that are already past EOL. All dates are month-precision and stored as YYYY-MM per AGENTS.md rule 4.
